_doc: P0 embedder bake-off (coverage-only) config. Reconstructed from RUN_CONFIG.md (2026-06-18 LongMemEval A/B, Arm A flat_dense). ONE variable = the encoder (+ its correct query/doc prefix). No answerer, no judge, no OpenAI, no Mandrel.
dataset_note: official LongMemEval-S, 500 questions (470 answerable + 30 abstention). Abstention qids end in '_abs'. Coverage denominator = 470 answerable. Corpus was cleaned upstream; MUST be the same longmemeval_s_cleaned.json used on 2026-06-18 for the MiniLM floor to reproduce (~85-93% coverage@8).

session_format.note: Exact Arm A / Mandrel-ingest formatting from run_eval_m2 (recovered via moat_pilot.py lines 89-100).
